findings.current: Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi surged toward the spearhead like the ebbing tide as it passed through the Conception and Governor Vessels.
findings.defect: The draft says the qi is currently passing through the vessels, but the source identifies its having surpassed one jiazi as a result of opening those vessels.
findings.rationale: 타통하며 refers to Taekyung opening the Conception and Governor Vessels, not to the qi merely traveling through them during the present attack.
findings.replacement: The Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi when I opened my Conception and Governor Vessels surged toward the spearhead like an ebb tide.
findings.source: 임독양맥을 타통하며 일 갑자를 넘어선 열양지기가 창날을 향해 썰물처럼 밀려든다.

findings.current: My target was the creature’s wing—the foreleg and arm at its front.
findings.defect: The appositive is awkward and obscures that the wing itself functions as the creature’s foreleg or arm.
findings.rationale: 앞발이자 팔이라 할 수 있는 directly characterizes the wing rather than identifying separate limbs at the creature’s front.
findings.replacement: My target was the creature’s wing, which served as both its foreleg and its arm.
findings.source: 목표는 놈의 앞발이자 팔이라 할 수 있는 날개.

findings.current: Within the thick cloud of dust rising around us, the fifty-meter-tall creature writhed.
findings.defect: The draft changes an unspecified fifty-meter bodily dimension into a fifty-meter height.
findings.rationale: 50m의 거체 describes the scale of its enormous body without specifying that it stands fifty meters tall.
findings.replacement: Within the thick cloud of dust rising around us, the creature’s fifty-meter bulk writhed.
findings.source: 뿌옇게 피어오른 흙먼지 속에서 50m의 거체가 몸부림치고 있었다.

findings.current: A single flap of its wings had shattered my entire body, and the head it had clutched in its claws had vanished without a trace. Those swallowed by its enormous maw had left behind not even corpses to find.
findings.defect: The draft inserts Taekyung as the victim whose entire body was shattered, while the source is recounting the Wyvern’s destruction of human victims generally.
findings.rationale: The omitted subjects belong to the catalogue of victims that continues into 이들은, and the following reflection concerns the blood, organs, and brutal deaths of human bodies generally.
findings.replacement: A single flap of its wings had shattered entire bodies, and heads seized in its claws had vanished without a trace. Not even the corpses of those swallowed by its enormous maw could be found.
findings.source: 날갯짓 한 번에 전신이 박살 났고, 발톱으로 움켜쥔 머리통은 흔적도 없이 사라졌다. 거대한 아가리에 삼켜진 이들은 시체조차 찾지 못했다.

findings.current: I landed lightly on the ground and stared at it with lowered eyes.
findings.defect: The draft turns the subdued, settled quality of Taekyung’s gaze into the physical action of looking downward.
findings.rationale: 가라앉은 눈빛 describes the controlled or somber quality of his gaze, not the direction of his eyes.
findings.replacement: I landed lightly on the ground and stared at it with a cold, steady gaze.
findings.source: 사뿐하게 지면에 착지한 나는 가라앉은 눈빛으로 놈을 응시했다.

findings.current:
Its eyes, full of resentment and killing intent, glared at me.

The emotions conveyed by that gaze were unlike anything I had ever known from a monster.

“Keep those eyes nice and gentle. Otherwise, I’ll pluck them out first.”
findings.defect: The draft repeatedly gives the explicitly one-eyed Wyvern multiple eyes and threatens to pluck out multiple eyes.
findings.rationale: 눈동자 and the contextual 눈 refer to the creature’s sole remaining eye; pluralizing them contradicts the scene’s defining physical fact.
findings.replacement:
Its eye, full of resentment and killing intent, glared at me.

The emotions conveyed by that gaze were unlike anything I had ever known from a monster.

“Keep that eye nice and gentle. Otherwise, I’ll pluck it out first.”
findings.source:
원한과 살기에 가득 찬 눈동자가 나를 노려본다.

그 눈빛에서 전해지는 온갖 감정은, 지금까지 내가 알던 몬스터의 그것이 아니었다.

“눈 착하게 떠라. 아니면 눈깔부터 뽑는다.”

findings.current: The instant it finished speaking, the red creature’s eyes were dyed a complete blood red.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Black Wyvern itself red and again gives it multiple eyes; the source describes its single red eye becoming entirely bloodred.
findings.rationale: 붉은 modifies the eye in context, while 눈동자 is singular and belongs to the one-eyed Black Wyvern.
findings.replacement: The instant it finished speaking, the creature’s red eye turned completely bloodred.
findings.source: 붉은 놈의 눈동자가 완전한 핏빛으로 물들었다.

findings.current: He ate other monsters and studied the magic equipment they carried instead of focusing on human flesh.
findings.defect: The pronoun “they” most naturally refers to the immediately preceding monsters, creating the false impression that those monsters carried the magic equipment.
findings.rationale: 그들이 refers to the humans contrasted with 인간의 고기; Carus investigates their magical equipment instead of treating them merely as food.
findings.replacement: He devoured other monsters and, rather than human flesh, studied the magic equipment the humans carried.
findings.source: 같은 몬스터들을 잡아먹었고, 인간의 고기보다는 그들이 갖고 있던 마법 장비를 탐구했다.

findings.current: Carus’s single eye rolled back as he immediately crossed the wasteland.
findings.defect: The draft literalizes 눈이 뒤집히다 as a physical eye movement, whereas the idiom means that Carus flew into a rage or saw red.
findings.rationale: 눈이 뒤집히다 describes losing control to an overwhelming emotion here, not rolling the eyeball backward.
findings.replacement: Carus saw red and immediately raced across the wasteland.
findings.source: 하나뿐인 눈이 뒤집힌 카루스는 곧장 황무지를 가로질렀다.

summary: Several subject, quantity, action, and mechanical errors require correction, including assigning past injuries to Taekyung, repeatedly giving the one-eyed Wyvern multiple eyes, and literalizing an idiom as a physical eye movement.
